blocks.html:
Commercial Pickup Truck Wrap in Toronto

So you’re thinking about getting a partial wrap for your company truck. You’ve already made the right decision by coming to Vinyl Wrap Toronto to understand the benefits of getting your company vehicle wrapped.

So why should you get a vinyl wrap on your truck? Well, your vehicle is a moving billboard for your company. Everywhere your truck goes, so does your company branding. And using well-designed graphics and colours will make it stand out from other vehicles around you.

For more examples of Pickup, Truck Wraps check out our other Truck Wraps

Now that you have seen what is possible. Let’s talk about the materials we use to create these stunning partial pickup truck wraps.

First off, we only use Avery Dennison and 3M vehicle-grade vinyl. Why is this important? Proper vehicle grade vinyl allows for bubble-free installation as well as it has a life expectancy of up to 8 years on your vehicle. And when it is time to remove it, it can be done without damaging the original paint job of your vehicle (This is assuming the original paint or clear coat has no pre-existing paint issues). Sounds like a win-win.

Other vinyl, what our industry calls ‘calendered’ vinyl is meant for signs, not your vehicle. So choosing only proper cast vinyl allows for your partial wrap to not shrink over time and start to cause visual issues with your wrap. You won’t EVER find a calendered vinyl on a vehicle wrap from Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

We can use a combination of pre-coloured vinyl or printable vinyl. This can allow your branding to really come to life on your wrap, by combining different materials and finishes you can create depth to what would normally be considered a flat visual.

Speaking of visuals. Do you need help with designing your truck wrap? Check out Branding Centres.

Marco ( The owner of Henao General Contractor ) was a delight to work with. He had a clear vision for his partial pickup truck wrap. And our designer was able to sit with him and make it happen. If you can believe it, this wrap was inspired by a T-shirt he had made months before.

We were able to take his logo and the colouring concept from the shirt and make his pickup truck a true one-of-a-kind. He loved the bold red and black, and so did we as it made the yellow of his logo really pop from the rest of the design. Being able to make the logo stand out is one of the most important parts of a good wrap.

If you are a business and want to advertise using your vehicle wrap, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is your go-to car wrap shop. Not only that, but we also specialize in signage and equipment wraps. To know the car wrap price, feel free to contact us or fill out the form and our experts will get back to you. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.
